symptom: ako/mxcli#1698 (mendixlabs/mxcli#1651): `textbox tb (Attribute: Name, Caption: 'Item name')` passed check and exec and the text box had no label — describe read `textbox tb (Attribute: Name)`, mx check 0 errors. Inputs take `Label:`; `Caption:` is a button's. The class: a property a built-in widget does not take (#1307 Tooltip, #1465 tab page CaptionParams, #1582 RenderMode, #1643) was never refused.
cause: MDL-WIDGET07 judged every built-in widget against staticWidgetKnownProps, the UNION of all built-in widgets' vocabularies, so a key valid on any widget passed on all of them. Measured on the per-kind sets: Visible: on a snippet call, scroll container, placeholder, layout header or menu widget is also dropped (their stored types have no ConditionalVisibilitySettings, so applyWidgetBase silently skips it), a scroll-container region writes only Class of its Appearance, and layouts were checked by no widget rule at all (documentWidgets has no CreateLayoutStmt case).
file: mdl/executor/widget_native_props.go (nativeWidgetKinds, nativeWidgetPropRefusals — the one verdict; validateNativeWidgetProps for check, refuseNativeWidgetProps in buildWidgetV3 and in each parent that builds a child itself); mdl/executor/validate_widgets.go (wired in validateWidgetTreeIn in place of MDL-WIDGET07 for built-in kinds, and a layout walk); mdl/executor/widget_native_props_source_test.go
insight: A per-type allow-list became safe to make a REFUSAL once it stopped being a hand-typed promise: TestNativeWidgetProps_MatchBuilderReads taint-walks the builders' source (go/parser, following the *ast.WidgetV3 argument through helper calls, literal keys incl. `range []string{…}`) and requires each kind's `reads` to equal what its builder reads, both ways; TestNativeWidgetProps_TailMatchesGen ties the common tail's Visible to whether the gen type the writer encodes has a SetConditionalVisibilitySettings setter; TestNativeWidgetProps_DescribeEmitsOnlyAccepted holds describe's per-$Type cases to the same sets. Two traps the scan needed: a helper that reads a key only to NAME the widget in an error (widgetRefForMessage reads Caption, so every input 'read' Caption — the very key of the bug), and positional keywords (`column`, `template`, `row`, `item`) whose builder depends on the parent — under a pluggable widget or at an ALTER INSERT root they are not built natively and must not be judged. Blast radius measured before choosing refuse over warn: 0 refusals across every non-.fail doctype/bug-test/deprecated-alias script, 0 across all skill and docs-site MDL blocks, and 0 in describe → check of every module of a blank 11.13 app, ako/TestApp and PedApp (~200 documents) and of 19 doctype page scripts exec'd into a fresh app. A new rejection, so gated per ADR-0011 like MDL-V1-TABPAGEPROP: MDL-WIDGET52 under mdl 1, MDL-V1-WIDGETPROP warning without the header.
